summary:
Implemented the terminal window title feature by editing files only; nothing was run or committed.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 as the last ControlType member, and added Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union. Mypy not run.
- rich/control.py: added the formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title(title) classmethod, which passes one two-item tuple.
- rich/console.py: added Console.set_window_title(title) after set_alt_screen. It checks only is_terminal, buffers the title control and returns True; otherwise it returns False and writes nothing.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: added one SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch at the end of the chain that calls term.set_title(title). The Win32 wrapper is unchanged.
- CHANGELOG.md: created an Added section above Fixed under Unreleased, with a bullet linking pull request 2200.
- Tests: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. None were run.

Not verified: tests, mypy, and Black were not run, since execution was disallowed.
